{{Quote|Scipio&hellip; Banking Clan&hellip; Senator Clovis&hellip; Baron Rush Clovis&hellip; Rush&hellip; Padmé? |[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], trying to guess [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis's]] hologram passcode|<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref>}}
[[File:BaronPapanoida-DaG.png|thumb|right|220px|Baron [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]]]
'''Baron''' was a title of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]]. [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] was a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] equivalent. [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]] held the title of Baron, as did [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] of [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]].

The head of the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] was a Baron or Baroness. Baroness [[Sanya Tagge/Legends|Sanya Tagge]] was succeeded in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] by her eldest son, [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]], until he died in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and was replaced by his youngest brother, [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric Tagge]]. In the case of the Tagges, the title of Baron was signified through a belt denoting title, which passed from Orman to his brother Ulric. The latter adding the belt to his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]].

In the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the title of Baron could be awarded to dedicated servants of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. [[Ragez D'Asta]], [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] and [[Merillion Tarko]] were all Barons in this way. The title of [[Baron of the Empire/Legends|Baron of the Empire]] was granted to Fel by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself.

==Barons==
[[File:RushClovis-SWE.png|thumb|right|220px|Baron Rush Clovis of Scipio]]
Baron was one of the titles of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] used by the ruling class in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was higher than the rank of [[Knight (noble rank)/Legends|Knight]], but below that of a [[Lord/Legends|Lord]]. Barons generally came from a [[Tapani Noble Houses|Noble House's]] "better" families, those with long histories and held in some measure of esteem. The title of Baron was inherited; as a result, no commoner could be raised to the title of Baron even if they had previously been raised to the position of Knight. However, a Knight's children could become Barons if they were also raised to the nobility.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

Barons were often found in control of House assets, such as important facilities like [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing plants]] and [[Armory/Legends|armories]]. Barons maintained a manor on the lands they controlled, as well as a home on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] to use in capital season.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" />
